description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git operations with verbose HTTP curl output. It sets up a repository, configures a mock HTTP server, and verifies error handling messages during a git clone operation.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Initiates a local HTTP server instance for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful completion of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Executes commands that are allowed to fail without causing test failure, used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
